---
# Source: manifest-stream/templates/app.yaml
# 1 (rendered first although install order would place the Service before it)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: release-name-app
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: release-name
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: release-name
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: nginx
---
# Source: manifest-stream/templates/app.yaml
# 3
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: release-name-app
spec:
  selector:
    app: release-name
  ports:
    - port: 80
---

# 5 (ordered by source path although install order would place it first)
